author: @KForKorea
text:
I am still mad that this didn't receive the best dance performance. This is insane. SEVENTEEN is insane for this yet this didn't get the recognition it deserved. I see no one, not even Carats mentioning Fear much. This mv is a work of art. 
"As a writer metaphorically expresses his/her message through an “ode,” SEVENTEEN also seeks to share their messages and stories to listeners through this album. “Fear” is an emotion many people encounter at least once in their lifetime. SEVENTEEN explores fear as an emotion they face during their creative process. As the members search within for insight, the agony they endure help them develop one step further as artists." -- written in the description box of the mv. 
The way the instrumental is arranged is a work of genius. Very few producers in KPop can even think about such arrangements. Their are multiple sounds mixed together at, layered at several places and that's the exact reason why the instrumental sounds kinda peculiar. Now coming to the lyrics. It's written like a novel, from start to end. The way it is toplined with the melody is a marvelous. The whispering parts, the beat drops, knowing exactly what to put where. 
The visuals of this mv is breathtaking. You can't help but keep your mouth hung low at the aesthetics. Each scene is unexpected. Each small details represents something that adds to the story and concept. 
If KPOp really was about music then Fear wouldn't be stuck here at 49M.

author: @alex-fs9yt
text: Props to Seventeen for always being so hard-working. They always put their all into choreographies, and there is not a single bad or incompetent dancer in the group. All of them can hold their own as dancers and still work together to perform synchronised masterpieces. On top of that, they are a self-producing group so a lot of the stuff we hear is actually the real them. Both the music and the lyrics. In my opinion, this song is very well-produced, the instrumentals are unique and the arrangement allows for these breathtaking pauses in the song where every member's voice can shine. And those are amazing vocals too! I never get tired of this song. I have so much admiration for Seventeen, a self-producing group even in this era of kpop where everything is about catchy songs instead of music with a meaning. Instead of outsourcing to make catchy money-making songs, like so many other artists, they stick to their own path. They actually do this for the music not the clout. Respect!

author: @alex-fs9yt
text: Considering the production value, this is extremely underrated in the context of kpop. This music video is well-made and aesthetically pleasing, and it suits Seventeen's dark concept perfectly. The song is also meaningful and showed a rare departure into Seventeen's dark side. Seventeen has stuck to music with a message. Music they worked hard on as self-producing idols. While the current trend for other kpop groups is to just make easy and catchy pop songs they know will do well, and getting hundreds of millions of views in just months. But this video only has 45 million views in over 2 years? Just shows that people value popularity and catchiness over hard work and well-made music with meaning. The sad reality of the music industry.

author: @redfoxakame
text:
Idk what people say, SEVENTEEN slayed this concept! Hear me out.

Yes, it's dark. Not the "put eyeliners on us" kind of dark, but *DARK.* It's FEAR. It's POISON. It's DEADLY (if left untreated). But what I love about SEVENTEEN is that _they don't stay dark._ After this, what did we get? FEARLESS, y'all! It's the _antidote_ to the poison! It's like they're telling us that even though there are dark moments in our lives where there is fear, *we should not remain there.* We should fight our fears. The presence of fear is not a bad thing, but letting the darkness consume you without resistance will ultimately destroy you.

So everyone, be FEARLESS. If that's too strong of a word, then I guess the message of the whole Henggarae will help (best album, imo). You see now how they slayed this concept? They're real artists. And come on! Look at their visuals here! They all look good. :>

author: @seventeen6201
text:
Welcome to the diamond life💎

Yes, they can pull off any concept, that's what I like the most about them. They can do any genre but still having a unique Seventeen style. They produce everything since lyrics, music, choreography, and more. Woozi is the main producer along with Bumzu (Pledis Artist) but Vernon and S.coups (+ most of the members) help writing songs too. 

Please check out (if you haven't already) their Japanese releases. They're on their Japan Official Youtube Channel. Seventeen is huge in Japan right now, their japanese music is really good, even some Japanese people think SVT is J-pop lol
Here are the Japanese songs so far:
Call Call Call
Happy Ending
Fallin' Flower
24H
Not alone (will be out in April)

In case you want to binge watch old content from them, I suggest going to Like17Subs, they have literally any show or content from them. Everything with english subs.

If you want to know the lyrics about b-side songs or older songs go to Seventeenlyrics channel, it's made by a Carat and it has the best translations and info about the songs like credits or references.
I'll leave you the link:
https://youtu.be/LTzDz_t6Wj4

If you have any specific questions please ask💎

TO ALL NEW VIEWERS OF THIS MV OR PEOPLE OUT THERE WHO'S TRYING TO STAN SEVENTEEN!!!
Here's a little guide for you:

- Seventeen is composed of 13 members but why Seventeen? 13 members + 3 units + 1 team  = 17
- Seventeen has 3 units as mentioned above: Hip-hop Team, Performance Team, Vocal Team (there's also a sub unit which is the BSS or BooSeokSoon)
- Seventeen are self-producing idols. They make their own songs and they also take a part on doing its own choreography.
- Seventeen debuted on May 25, 2015.
- Their fandom is called "Carats" 

Seventeen Members:
 0:02 - Wonwoo (real name: Jeon Wonwoo - hip-hop team)
 016 - Joshua (real name: Hong Joshua/Jisoo - vocal team)
 0:23 - Jeonghan (real name: Yoon Jeonghan - vocal team)
 0:28 - Mingyu (real name: Kim Mingyu - visual/hip-hop team)
 0:34 - Vernon (real name: Hansol Vernon Chwe - hip-hop team/korean-american member)
 0:42 - Woozi (real name: Lee Jihoon - leader of vocal team/composer)
 0:49 - The8 (real name: Xu Minghao - performance team/chinese member)
 0:53 - Seungkwan (real name: Boo Sengkwan - main vocalist/bss)
 0:56 - Hoshi (real name: Kwon Soonyoung - leader of performance team/choreographer/bss/tiger)
 1:02 - DK or Dokyeom (real name: Lee Seokmin - main vocalist/leader of bss)

 1:27 - S.Coups (real name: Choi Seungcheol - leader of seventeen/leader of hip-hop team)
 1:54 - Jun (real name: Moon Junhui - performance team/chinese member)

Hope you'd join us and be part of our family! Being Carat is really fun! It doesn't matter if we are on top or not. I was new to K-Pop back then when I knew Seventeen and trying to find the group that fits my style, of course I found one and started focusing on them. for those who's thinking 

*"Why should I vote on MAMA when it's obvious who will win?"*

Here's the logical answer:
It's bcos votes only account to 20%-30% of the final winner criteria. In AOTY % BMG, 30% is also determined by judges panel, and the rest are from digital and album sales, which I can say, is definitely not a little, especially since we became a triple million seller. In SOTY & Best Dance Performance, the percentage of judges panel is even bigger: 40%! 

This means we still have a chance, a large chance in my opinion, to win any of those awards. That is, if we can *close the gap* between votes, vote properly, diligently everyday! *Isn't it such a waste if the judges give svt favorable scores compared to others, but we lose because our votes gap is too big??*

And also there's a specia prize (best music video) where 70% of the criteria comes from the judges panel. The rest? Global mv vi3ws. That's why we need to str17m everytime we have nothing to do. 

Another thing I want to add, for APAN Best Group for Man, 100% of the votes will be reflected on the award, and we're currently no. 1!!! I'm very proud of this and if we all could work together and prevent other groups from stealing the lead, I'm sure we can add another trophy to seventeen's wall of fame! 

This is what I think and I hope this can encourage you all in voting and str17ming because I really want to see svt getting the recognition (and awards) they deserve!!

KBS’s “Music Bank” is making a small change to how it calculates its weekly chart rankings.

According to the show’s official website, the digital music charts that are used to calculate the rankings for “K-Chart” will change as of November 3.

Soribada will be removed and FLO will be added. This means that, starting the week of November 3, “Music Bank” will calculate its weekly rankings from a total of five digital music charts: Melon, Bugs, Genie Music, Naver Vibe, and FLO.

The “K-Chart” on “Music Bank” is calculated through a combination of digital music charts, album sales, the amount of broadcasts, and viewer choice charts. The rankings on this chart determine who will win “Music Bank” each week.

author: @vyn_veny274
text:
SEVENTEEN/ SVT (세븐틴) adalah boy grup asal Korea Selatan bentukan Pledis Entertainment. Mereka terdiri dari S.coups, Junghan, Joshua, Jun, Hoshi, Wonwoo, Woozi, DK, Mingyu, The8, Seungkwan, Vernon, Dino. Seventeen juga di bagi dalam 3 unit yaitu Vocal Team, Hip Hop Team dan Performence Team. Nama Seventeen juga bisa di artikan seperti ini: 13 anggota + 3 sub-unit + 1 grup = 17 (Seventeen).

￼￼

 

Seventeen memulai debutnya pada tanggal 26 Mei 2015 dengan lagu “Adore U” dipanggung MBC Music. Lagu tersebut merupakan lead track dari album mini pertama Seventeen berjudul ‘17 Cara’t yang baru resmi diluncurkan pada tanggal 29 Mei. Sukses dengan debutnya, Seventeen mengeluarkan album mini keduanya bertajuk ‘Boys Be’ pada tanggal 10 September 2015. Merekapun promosi lagu andalanya yaitu “Mansae” di program-program musik mingguan. Meski baru debut, Seventeen sudah mendapat beberapa penghargaan, seperti di Golden Disk Awards, Seoul Music Awards dan Gaon K-Pop Chart Awards. Selain itu juga, Seventeen merupakan satu-satunya grup k-pop yang masuk daftar di Billboard “21 Under 21 2015”.

￼￼

Setelah menggelar konser solonya bertajuk “Like Seventeen – Boys Wish” pada bulan Februari 2016 lalu, mereka langsung menetapkan nama fandomnya, yaitu CARAT. Mereka juga mengumumkan kalau akan segera comeback dengan album pertama. Setelah persiapan matang, akhirnya Seventeen comeback dengan lagu “Pretty U” dari album perdananya ‘Love & Letter’ yang resmi dirilis pada tanggal 25 April 2016. Sejak debut pada bulan Mei 2015 lalu, akhirnya Seventeen meraih trofi pertamanya dipanggung Show Champion pada tanggal 4 Mei 2016 dengan lagu “Pretty U”. Kemudian, mereka merilis album repackage dari album sebelumnya, dengan judul ‘Love & Letter Repackage Album’ pada 4 Juli 2016. Di album repackage ini terdapat tambahan 5 buah lagu yaitu NO. F.U.N, Healing, Simple, Can’t See The End, dan Very Nice dipilih sebagai lead tracknya. Menutup tahun 2016, Seventeen comeback dengan lagu “Boom Boom” yang merupakan bagian dari album mini ketiganya ‘Going Seventeen’ yang dirilis pada tanggal 5 Desember.

Pada tanggal 22 Mei 2017, Seventeen akhirnya comeback dengan lagu “Don’t Wanna Cry”. Lagu tersebut merupakan bagian dari album mini keempat mereka berjudul ‘Al1’. Usai promosi lagu barunya, Seventeen melanjutkan kegiatanya dengan menggelar tur dunia pertama mereka bertajuk “Diamond Edge”. Pada tanggal 6 November 2017, Seventeen comeback dengan album lagu baru berjudul ‘Clap. Lagu tersebua merupakan lead singel dari album kedua Seventeen berjudul “TEEN, AGE”.

￼￼

Suddenly the memories flashed by again ㅠㅠㅠㅠ I remember coming home from school and immediately went to yt just to watch this masterpiece :"" I remember rushing ahaha omg

 This era is so SO special to me. It might've been my 2nd comeback with them but it's the actual comeback where I considered myself as a carat. This era might've been slept on but it was super iconic while it lasted. This era was the part 2 of their success. 700k albums sold, it was THE album that gave them a daesang; their dream :"" 

An Ode had gotten the title "ALBUM OF THE YEAR (2019)" and obviously, it's well deserved.

For every track in this album, I had memories with it. Not only memories because of SEVENTEEN and CARATS but memories with my own personal life too. And all the tracks in this album provided nostalgia because for every listen, I immediately feel as if I was in the past again, living the best moment of my life :" and YES I'm talking about EVERY TRACK.

Until now, I can't believe I've been playing this album for a whole year officially. And the game is still going strong :D I think I'll still play this whole album even if SVT comes back with another album ahahaha

This was the best era in my opinion because I have my sentimental values within it :""

text:
Actually the ones that didn't like this era was mostly k-carats I think international carats were in love to An Ode era.
And yes, SVT started with a fresh and young concept in their title tracks like Adore U and Mansae and it was one of the reasons they were really popular when they debuted beacuse it was something new and original.

Then cute concept in Pretty U but if you listen to the first Album (Love&Letter) it wasn't something just cute...  they had emotional songs and darker and heavier bsides since a looooong time ago. 

I personally think since Teen Age album we saw a lot more darker sound in some songs like Flower, Lilili Yabbay and Trauma.
And actually that Album is the beggining for a new era in seventeen, that's why they created a song talking about that. (Change up)
And that's one of the things I like about SVT, they can pull off any concept they want without being weird or uncomfortable. Concepts kings

author: @hoshitmykimbap8840
text:
*An essay no one asked for:*
This song started with the chorus which is Wonwoo's only line and then you can suddenly hear the instrumentals drop and its so friking wonderful. I feel like when Joshua sings his first line - he sings it very softly as if its the peak of his worry or fear. Similarly Jeonghan on the second verse gave out a similar vibe. When the rappers on the first verse (Mingyu and Vernon) and second verse (Dino and S.coups) began rapping its as if theyre getting frustrated by their fear - its similar to ranting. Woozi and Seungkwans pre choruses is then toned down because it kinda reminds me of "the calm before the storm" (this applies to the bridge too) and the "Someone tell me what should i do?" Is obviously their cry for help. And can we also appreciate how the bridge also toned down and then suddenly they gave us such a powerful last chorus that doesnt even sound like the chorus (it means its rlly different and unique. I take OH MY, L&R as an example, The lyrics of the chorus are the same) Woozi's "This is love.." Is so powerful. The bridge till the end always gives me goosebumps.
Most said that the chorus isnt very powerful but i actually think that theyre actually just simply asking for a favor that 'they' should rlly go away because theyre (SVT) poison. It wasnt meant to sound aggressive at any way.

In conclusion, Woozi and all members has a wonderful brain~ (Edit: I cant believe i forgot to credit Bumzu and the producers too T^T bakSU to them for having wonderful brains!!)

Only real gems appreciate this :")) This is all ive noticed^^ because Ive been listening to this song for 10 months everyday. And we rlly need to hit 35M for its first bday bcuz this masterpiece deserves it UwU, Fighting and thanks for reading aksks

HOSHI HARUS LIHAT INI (:

Bolu Macan

Bahan :
10 butir kuning telur
5 / 6 butir putih telur
400 grm margarin ( boleh mix butter ya)
400 grm gula halus ( saya 300 grm)
300 grm terigu segitiga
100 grm susu bubuk fullcream
5 sdm susu kental manis ( saya 3 sdm )
2 sdm coklt bubuk + 1 sdt pasta coklat
cara :
mikser margarin+mentega dan gula halus hingga mengembang, masukan kutel satu persatu sambil dimikser. masukan susu kental manis mikser sebantar, masukan bahan tepung lainnya yg sudah diayak terlebih dahulu ( bole pake mikser speed rendah / spatula)

mikser putih telur hingga mengembang dan kaku ( jika baskom dibalikan kocokan putih telur tidak tumpah/jatuh)
campur ke adonan kuning tadi aduk rata.ambil sedikit adonan beri coklat bubuk dan pasta aduk rata.
tuang dalam loyang 20/22 cm yg oles margarin ditaburi tepung tipis, tuang adonan selang seling.
panggang dengan oven suhu 175’c hingga matang.

author: @willywonka2217
text:
GUIDE

Fandom name: Carat
Official colors: Rose Quartz and Serenity

Seventeen is a group that debuted under Pledis Entertainment* in May 26, 2015. They are called seventeen because  of the logic 13 members + 3 sub units + 1 team = 17. They are mostly known for their synchronization and being self produced

(*It's getting annoying to explain it multiple times since I've been commenting guides on newer mv's. It's not needed to comment on everything and say pledis is under bh now. Let those that aren't updated understand it themselves. Pledis/ Seventeen has a twitter account for a reason.)

Edit: They are not called seventeen because they used to have 4 other pre members. The most members they had was 16. (Minghao was still not a trainee that time then when he arrived, some members left.) Even before they had 13 members they're already called seventeen. I've read somewhere that they're called seventeen because the ages of the trainees were around/near 17.

Their most viewed mv as of now is Don't Wanna Cry (165M) and is sadly the only Seventeen mv to surpass 100M

They are having their 7th mini album on June 22. They currently have 3 full albums, 6 mini albums, 1 repackage, 1 japanese mini album, 2 japanese singles, 1 single, 1 special album

Members: (this is how their order goes)
1:27 Choi Seungcheol (stage name: S.Coups) 08.08.1995 | is the oldest and the overall leader of seventeen. He is a member and also the leader of *Hip-Hop Unit*
1:09 Yoon Jeonghan (stage name: Jeonghan) 10.04.1995 | Is the second oldest and is a member of the *Vocal Unit*
 1:15 Hong Jisoo/ Joshua Hong (stage name: Joshua) 12.30.1995 | He is a full korean but was born in America and is one of the English speaking members. He is also a member of the *Vocal Unit*
1:53 Moon Junhwi / Wen Junhui (Stage name: Jun) 06.10.1996 | is one of the chinese members. He is a member of *Performance Unit*
0:55 Kwon Soonyoung (Stage name: Hoshi) 06.15.1996 | is a member of the *Performance unit* He also helps in the group's choreography. He calls himself tiger and is known to have a lot of tiger related stuff.  (stuffed toy, belt, phone case, etc.)
0:03 Jeon Wonwoo (stage name: Wonwoo) 07.17.1996 | is a member of the *Hip-Hop Unit* He likes cats. He said that even though he may look cold due to his sharp eyes, he's a warm person (and he really is uu)
0:42 Lee Jihoon (stage name: Woozi) 11.22.1996 | is the producer and is a member of the *vocal unit* Seventeen's self-producing idol title all started with him. (The other members also help in producing ofcourse)
1:18 Seo Myungho / Xu Minghao (stage name: The8) 11.07.1997 | is one of the chinese members of the group alongside Jun. He likes the number 8, wine and usually draws and paints. He is a member of the *Performance unit*
0:28 Kim Mingyu (stage name: Mingyu) 04.06.1997 | is a member of the *Hip-Hop unit* He, alongside dk and minghao are part of the "97 liners" with BTS' Jungkook, Got7's Yugyeom and Bambam and Astro's Eun Woo
0:20 Lee Seokmin (stage name: DK / Dokyeom) 02.18.1997 | is a member of the *vocal unit* He is a sweet ray of sunshine uuuu. He also played the lead role as King Arthur in the musical 'Xcalibur'
1:35 Boo Seungkwan (stage name: seungkwan) 01.16.1998 | is a member of the *vocal unit* He is known for his skill in variety. 
0:35 Hansol Vernon Chwe / Choi Hansol (stage name: Vernon) 02.18.1998 | is the other member of america line alongside Joshua. He is half american and half Korean. He is a member of the *Hip-Hop unit*
1:22 Lee Chan (stage name: Dino) 02.11.1999 | is the maknae of seventeen. He is a member of the *Performance unit* He also makes his own danceologies

I recommend watching the mv's by date, from debut upto Left & Right. They currently have 3 Japanese mv's

If you're having troubles in memorising their faces/names etc., I suggest these methods:
- Memorize them by unit
- Watch their ep in Knowing Bros
- Watch Going Seventeen*

*Going seventeen is an ongoing series that gets a new ep every monday at 10:10pm KST. You can start watching from Going Seventeen 2019 since going svt 2018/17 are mostly about behind the scenes of their concerts and don't have subtitles.

Some might've noticed this already but they have A LOT of contents
- 17TV (Training, you'll see the four other pre members there, no subs)
- 17 project (final lineup, right before their debut)
- Going svt
- Going svt spin-off (it's not that different compared to the current gsvt. But since gsvt spin off aired around 2018 when gsvt was still about behind the scenes of concerts, they called it spin-off)
- Hit The Road (documentary, it shows a wider insight behind their success)
- part switch dance practices (I'm warning you its not as normal as it sounds like lmaoo) 
- Inside svt (casual moments, backstage, trips, etc.)
- Dino's Danceology
- 1min7sec challenge (they have to do things in that time limit)
- IF seventeen (I'm not sure if it's discontinued or finished)
- SVT Club 
- One Fine Day in Yeoseodo 2016 (They had to do things on their own in a small island, they did a lot of things like fishing, farming, etc.)
- One fine day in Japan 2017 (They had to do challenges. They were divided to 2 teams: Hyung and dongsaeng)

*You might see some going moment vids but it's just a short compilation of the best moments in each going svt ep. 

Watching their dance relays and dance practices is satisfying too I suggest watching them to see how hard and complex their choreos really are. 

Bonus: There's a youtuber named Elliot New Village that makes seventeen dance analyses (also other groups too). He explains every detail in their choreos. If you're into dancing, I really recommend watching his vids. He is reallyyy informative and does clear explanations.

Also please check out their b side tracks since they are very underrated. You can listen to them on spotify/ seventeenlyrics channel here on yt

(You can know more about them on kprofiles, I don't really recommend watching old guide to seventeen videos because it contains jokes that carats agreed to leave behind)

Streaming this before we get comeback teaser in a couple of hours.

Almost 11 month later we say goodbye to the most important and meaningful era for/of Seventeen. Nothing challenged them & us more than this era. I dont need to say everything we went through, if you know, you know. I remember when it got to a point this felt like a cursed, bitter era. Despite all the achievements and the top tier album. The down and falls felt harder than the ups & glories. We were all struggling in silence (or not as obvious) because we knew how much the boys themselves were also struggling. 
It's in though times that push us to make it or break it. We made it. We're stronger and reassured the love & bond between us & them is real. I wont forget this era and everything I learned and what it proved to me.
Farewell An Ode/ Fear. You were certainly bitter sweet, but unforgettable

author: @atenar6573
text:
@@athulyacb7096
 Seventeen's fandom is called "Carat". Because fans make them shine like a diamond (Carat is the measure of precious stones, the more carat more pure and valuable the stone is). 
In the boys 'predebut song called "Shining diamond" they describe everything they have had to go through to get there, what expectations they have as a group and how they are going to achieve it. In addition to this, they invite people to walk this path with them with the phrase "slip into the diamond life" and that of the diamond is because they make an analogy between their identity and diamonds In which they describe that they have been formed under a lot of pressure (such as diamonds that are formed in environments of too much pressure). They also mention how strong that has made them (such as diamonds that are described as the strongest objects) also refer to the diversity in their team and that they are eye-catching like diamonds.
So now when someone is new in the fandom it is customary to say "Welcome to the diamond life"

author: @crymealiver5078
text:
I always thought being a multifandom was a myth. As I am a loyal EXO-L, I thought I could never like another group as much. But I randomly saw a vid about Seventeen on Facebook and I thought they were funny, so I decided to check them out. I check out other group's songs from time to time and I like some, but was never enough to stan them. The first video I watched was Pretty U. I mean it's 2020 and Svt lured me with Pretty U lmao. I thought it was the only song that I would like, but maaan they have amazing discography and their choreographies are beyond perfect. Adding to that I learned that they are self producing idols. Before I knew it, I was watching every Svt videos. From live performances to crack vids.

Now I can finally call myself a Carat. I was really very conflicted if it was right to stan another group, but seeing how talented and hardworking Svt is, there was definitely no turning back. They deserve all the love and support that they get. They are literally all the nicest things in the world combined. Although I regret stanning them late, I am definitely in this for the long haul. They make my heart so happy. I love you Seventeen! I love you co-Carats! <3

text:
I wish people would appreciate this song like how it deserves it. Seventeen  not only got out of their comfort zone showing a completely different side of them concept-wise; but they have said over and over again, that this song represent their feelings at the moment, the uncertainity of the future and the pressure of the expectations. For them to let us see this vulnerable side of them is such a brave thing to do, but also a way of showing their gratitude and the amount of trust they have in their audience. 
Yet, despite all this, some people have the audacity of calling this "too dark" or "too weird" and that it's not like them without even thinking of giving them a chance first smh.

text: @E Ch In all the awards ceremonies at the end of last year, all the groups were badly treated by the MAMA's television station, giving them very little time and bad shots. author: @aeiara
text:
I just read a beautiful comment about someone wishing well for the health for SVT, especially Woozi, as he is the producer of the group. And that got me thinking, SVT is known for their choreo, how long do they actually practise for it? The answer was simply found in a meme video, where Minghao spoiled HIT choreography almost a year back before its release. Just imagine, practicing new choreo for a comeback so far ahead, practising countless countless choreo of the past, preparing special stages, actually crafting the choreo themselves, the amount they spend on this is insane. Everyone praises SVT for being talented and amazing at dancing, but the sheer hardwork they put behind it is so very overlooked, it bothers me. 1 year and possibly more for a comeback. The heck would you see a group like this? And when Hoshi said that Jeonghan would practise more because he had to keep up with them;  I just imagine the members who truly weren't that gifted in the field of dance, but put the hardwork and effort to overcome that obstacle. Many groups just leave it to the main dancers to uphold the group's reputation, but SVT works for perfection. They are truly an amazing group.

Edit 09/12/2020 - Definitely the HIT thing was wrong as pointed by a lovely and friendly and beautiful Carat below lol, but it doesn't undermine anything. They are perfect in all their old choreography and new ones, without slacking off anywhere or losing motivation. Seungkwan has a ankle injury yet he danced his part, and he has had this injury for a long time (since HIT) and you all saw in HTR how his legs were bandaged and even got surgery, Wonwoo refusing to yield his performance even after he hyperventilated, he was determined to perform and then collapse, you all can see how much they all truly work, being at the top, they have accumulated so many wounds physically and mentally, yet they go strong and never compromise. Stan SEVENTEEN!

author: @dianamontoya4413
text:
I understand your frustration, but the sad reality is that there are many causes for what happens with SEVENTEEN.
First, they have an INEFFICIENT AND COMPLETELY IRRESPONSIBLE company, capable of doing horrible things with their groups, as we saw with Pristin. Pledis never supports his groups as he should, not even SVT.
On the other hand, SVT fans are, for the most part, multifandoms, that is, they come here, support for a while and then leave. The Carats stay, but for some reason they get easily discouraged and I think it's because they are very young girls and they easily forget.
SEVENTEEN is doing very well, great, and I think everything that is published about novice groups is not always real. Remember that recently it was discovered that there were companies that cheated, not only with subscribers, but with likes or seen. The music environment is disgusting, and everyone knows it, the statistics that are published are not real and we cannot believe everything that is published, because everything is handled according to commercial interests, making fans get scared or join the most popular groups, just managing an elementary psychology.
I honestly believe that the Carats are doing well, that we don't have to be discouraged and that over time, things will be accommodated as they should. Just wait a little longer.

author: @dianamontoya4413
text:
Good night.
I have been reading the comments and I am surprised that there are still people who talk about "entering a family" referring to what Pledis will do with another larger company. It seems to me that we should be realistic, and not assume that everything will be like in a fairy tale and that the groups of companies will be like brothers and will love each other forever.
Nothing is more false than this. SEVENTEEN is a group that has a contract with Pledis, and thanks to that, Pledis gets a lot of money, too much money, every time SVT does come back or do concerts or anything else. There is no filial love, and there is nothing but money between them. That's why Pledis abuses. And I think that all companies abuse the same, because all groups, ALL have contracts where they give a percentage of their money to the company that represents them, and that is something we all know.
So, please, don't think that now things will be better or that they will change into something. SEVENTEEN will have to continue working very hard, without rest, and still sick, because Pledis will continue to exploit his talent and sympathy without caring about anything else. And it doesn't matter that they now belong or are in dealings with another agency, because things will stay the same. I just hope that the Carats can learn to be more united and thus support SVT, because I think it is an important moment in their life as artists, and that they will need us more than ever. Let us support ALL members and not just our favorite, because that is how we support the SVT UNIT, and therefore, their work.

text: Good Morning. I haven't commented for a long time, but I've been watching Woozi's videos with Bumzu and, really, I realize the beautiful friendship between those two boys. It is a pity that Pledis no longer drives his co-producer, because Bumzu intervenes in all the songs that all Pledis groups do, so he should give him more support, regardless of SEVENTEEN being his best group, or at least, the more popular. author: @dianamontoya4413
text:
@Appreciate Dino everyone!! You're right. Bumzú is not only a co-producer and composer of Pledis, he is a talented and very valuable soloist who could well be more successful if they only publicized his activities. How is it possible that we learn about their concerts just by seeing the images of Woozi or Hoshi? He is unfair and I feel sad for him, but I see that he is a good friend of them and I hope he always is.
On the other hand, the SVT tour can be postponed, and I do not say it because they already came to Mexico and we are happy about it, but because in reality it is not yet known how the coronavirus is transmitted and they are in danger just by approaching the area the dangerous. Even if I were Pledis, I would have them isolated in South Korea, and without interacting with anyone else. Like Nuest and all my artists, because they are not just money, but they are human beings and if something bad happens to them, there is no money that can replace them.

author: @dianamontoya4413
text:
Hi, it's 9 pm at CDMX. Friday was the concert of SEVENTEEN and in truth, it is the best concert I have attended. I have been fortunate to be able to go to almost all the KPOP concerts that have been presented in Mexico, since 2015, starting with the Music Bank, and then several more. I don't like girl groups, so I don't include them, but of the boy groups, I've gone to all but Big Bang and Got 7. No offense to anyone, but really SEVENTEEN are pure talent. The sound of their voices is the same as in the MVs and their dance is identical, it even seemed that I saw the screen of my computer, but no, they were, live and completely perfect.
The only regret is that they really looked very tired. Jeonghan said he was dizzy and The8 was grouped. I did not know that they had just returned from Seoul, from an awards.
I wonder why they were not given more time to adapt to the height of CDMX. We are 3 thousand meters above sea level and that is very high. But as always, Pledis ignored something so elementary.
Then I learned that on Monday they gave a concert in LA, USA. Is incredible!
I really think that one day, one of them will collapse for so much work and so much pressure to which they are all subjected. I hope not, but I'm afraid to think about it.
PLEASE PLEDIS, LET THEM REST MORE BETWEEN CONCERT AND CONCERT !!!!

text: Watching / hearing the music with close eyes: after months still my FAVORITE comeback after AL1 and YMMDawn (i love Teen.Age, but mostly cuz of the b-sides - clap is awsome tho). Fear is so complex, it's not a song that we can easily digest and hear - like the whole album. The song isn't an automatic pop, with traps beats and synthetises. In Fear the constructions, the bridges, the chorus and pre-chorus, the ending .. are musicaly perfection, with the high and hide notes, it has ups and downs that's out of expectations, and this is SO FUCKING GOOD! It's not only dark bcuz of woozi's fears and concerns, but it's very mature musically, and this make me really proud not only as fans, but as someone who really love to listen and learn music. Maybe I dont like  all songs in the album, but it's not they're bad or that I've been badmouthing Seventeen, it's taste too. So here is a tip: stop, are listen carefully, with close eyes, feel you song, try to separate all of the song elements (there are many, so it maybe be hard), and enjoy. 2019 IT REALLY WAS SEVENTEEN'S YEAR, STILL IS AND THE NEXT WILL BE TOO! AGAIN N AGAIN, ON REPLAY! <3

text: Hi Carats. I am reading the congratulations you give SEVENTEEN, and of course, I understand that you deserve them well. Not only do they deserve the prizes they have been given but others that were stolen, but in the end, nothing can be done to erase that. However, I want to congratulate the Carats who, loyal as always, were there, voting and supporting them. Regardless of what I think about the parody of the awards, EVERYONE, I love the innocence and enthusiasm of the Carats and I want to tell you that you also deserve a great prize. I cannot give you anything more than a writing, but I give it to you with all sincerity, because I know that you are beyond any trap or agreement that is made with the votes and the awards and I also understand that companies reward the popular because if no, maybe they wouldn't have sponsors and the business would end. Business is rubbish, but fans always love me because I see that enthusiasm and push to do things. I insist that I do not vote because I do not believe in the cleanliness of the awards, but I love that they have all that encouragement. I really respect them and I hope they always have that same spirit, in every aspect of their life, and they get the success they deserve too.

author: @BiSTHN
text:
Seventeen is well known for their funky, fresh songs from their early years, so if that sounds like your thing, try Adore U, Mansae, Pretty U and Aju Nice! For a more rock style, try Clap and Call Call Call. Recently they've been moving more into an electronic, modern style like Don't Wanna Cry and Oh My. SVT's three sub-units, vocal, hip-hop and performance units also each have their own kind of style. 


Vocal unit has a lot of ballads (Pinwheel, Habit, Don't Listen in Secret) but some more upbeat songs too, like Come to Me and Second Life. Hip-hop unit songs range from aggressive (Un Haeng Il Chi, Back it Up) to more laidback like If I, Check In and Chilli. Trauma is probably the best known hip-hop unit song! Perfomance team, my personal favourite, have a really unique style, I love it. I recommend Lilili Yabbay (you have to watch the MV, the choreo is so incredible), Moonwalker, Swimming Fool, 247. 


SVT also like to switch it up and they have songs by various members put together! Off the top of my head, there's Change Up, Still Lonely, Flower, Network Love, A-TEEN. There are also a few duet songs like Rocket, My I, Falling for U, Bring It. Sorry for the super long reply, but SVT has such a wide range of songs that I'm sure you'll find something you love!

text: I love how Seventeen comes back with a different concept for their comebacks EVERY SINGLE TIME. They truly care about their fans by providing the best quality music they can make and I think that's what made them so successful in Korea and overseas. I'm so proud to be a Carat and represent our boys as the supportive individual they want us to be. It makes me tear up remembering how these 13 boys were fighting over toothpaste and wondering if they were ever going to debut to becoming one of the most successful boy groups of all time. I really hope they win MAMA Artist of the Year because they deserve it.

author: @rapvernonie
text:
SEVENTEEN didnt FEAR to rip they emotions insecurities of into An Ode. That's why the album is a rollercoaster of feels. That's why is a complex, diverse, deep insight into their soul as artist but also as humans. 
In a era of 'streaming the receipts and formula for a instant success and gp friendly songs can be tempting but not for them. The concept of Dead Poetry Society is well explored as they are one of the last remaining passionates for the art of creating music, self expression and creativity freedom.
They are very well know for self producing their craft. They are more artists than idol. 
Awarding An Ode as the Album of The Year is more than deserved, is also a repair from the sleepisness gp in Korea seems to give them.
As long as K-pop has them, the poetry, the magic of music and its power to be significant and meaninful will remain alive.

After hearing about S.coups having anxiety, his rap at 1:28 became even more painful for me. It was definitely him already crying out for it.
And in the same scene where he's watching dino is like a symbolism that even though he's going through something, he's still there to watch over his younger members. And since dino is surrounded with microphones, it's like S.coups is watching over them and protecting them from the public.

author: @gorajuni4248
text:
“Even though he’s going through something, he still there to watch over his younger members...”
YOU REALLY GOT THE POINT GURL

I feel this.. and I think he did that because he didn’t want to disappointed anyone else, in case he’s the one that given those responsibility to be a leader. So, he need to leads his members until the very end. He should to take care his members first before himself. 

Like Woozi said before, “I think, I have the biggest responsibilities to the future of the others. How if I messed everything up? How if everyone failed because of me? For that, I really have to do my best for others”
How if S.coups also feel this way? I feel so bad even just imagined this things.

Thinking about that now is really hurtful and breaks my heart. I cannot even imagine what’s the feeling he has now. How painful he feels, how hard he tried to overcome his personal problems and also svt’s problems at the same time.

I, myself also struggling from some of psychological problems, but still.. I cannot feel the way he feels. I don’t experience something like he did. All I can do is just praying the best for him. It’s all about personal healing. Everyone have different way to deal with it. Also different time/phase to feel okay again. Maybe it’ll take several weeks, but it also could’ve take several months or years, depending on the person.

I just sincerely hope the very best for him. I hope he gets a really good time to rest to clear his mind, also to take a better care for himself like he always do for his 12 brothers.

And someday, he’ll comeback with his new energy, even brighter than before. :)

text:
잘자, 플레 디스
나는 당신이 다른 언어로 된 주석을 볼 때 당신이 그것을 읽을 수 없다고 생각하기 때문에 당신의 언어로 당신에게 쓰고 있습니다.
San Google의 도움을 받아 모든 SEVENTEEN 동영상의 자막이 얼마나 중요한지 알려 드리고자합니다.
나는 그것이 추가적인 노력이고 한국어를 배우는 것이 좋을 것임을 이해하지만 멕시코에서는 언어를 배우는 것이 비싸고 시간이 많이 걸립니다.
나도 없어
SEVENTEEN은 나에게 많은 의미를 지니고 있으며 엄마가 인터넷을 사용하여 집에있을 때 그것들을 봅니다. 그러나 길거리 나 학교에서, 또는 다른 일을하고 있으면 접근 할 수 없습니다. 나는 가난한 나라에서 왔지만 13 명의 소년을 사랑하고 가능할 때마다 그 말을 듣습니다.
보유하고있는 최고의 그룹의 모든 동영상을 영어로 자막을 작성하면 판매 및 구독자 및 조회수가 증가 함을 알 수 있습니다. 나는 당신을 확신합니다
나는 무례한 것을 좋아하지 않기 때문에 모든 것을 존중합니다.
SVT가 더 높은 곳에 도달하도록 도와주세요. 그것은 우리 모두에게 적합합니다.


Good night, Pledis.
I am writing to you in your language, because I think that when you see comments in another language you don't read them.
So, aided by San Google, I want to tell you how important it is to subtitle ALL SEVENTEEN videos.
I understand that it is an extra effort, and that it would be good to learn Korean, but in Mexico, learning a language is expensive and time consuming.
I do not have either.
SEVENTEEN means a lot to me, and I see them when I'm at home using the internet my mom pays. But on the street or at school, or doing other things, I can't access it. I am from a poor country, but I love the 13 boys and I listen to them whenever I can.
Please, subtitle in English all the videos of the best group you have and you will see that your sales and subscribers and views will increase. I assure.
I write to you with all due respect, because I don't like being rude.
Please help SVT reach higher. It suits us all.

text: Guys, Help Me? I'm stressed out. I Can't help My life. What should I do? Help me.

author: @valentinasvt247
text: Oh no, dear :( that sounds very bad. You should figure out what causes your stress and then try to get rid of it. I know, easier said than done :(  Try to get distance to things that makes you feel sad or stressed. Always remember: there's nothing more important than health  (physical & mental)! Do more things that make you happy & that help you to forget the stress ♡  I think you know the best what makes you happy :) (when I feel too much stress it helps me often to go for a walk outside, you know, to be in different surroundings can distract)

author: @dianamontoya4413
text:
Ok, first of all, try to calm down. You did very well in writing what you feel, because that helps you. It is a cognitive way of exercising control over your mind and your anxiety.
If you feel very anxious, with that feeling that you are going to scream or something worse, put ice on your neck, that will give you an impact that will make that horrible feeling that you feel when you think it is very bad disappear. I have felt it and my psychologist has recommended me to do it when I am in crisis.
Another thing you can do to calm down is to observe the objects you have around and describe them, for example, a pen, if it is red, or of another color, if it has a lid or not, the material, and if it is sharp pointed or round, and so, you can think of things absolutely out of your current problem.
Breathe deeply, when the air enters through your nose, inflate your abdomen and slowly count to where you hold and then, when you take out the air, put the abdomen and keep counting.
Everything you do should be to keep you from thinking about your problem. The most important thing is that you take control of your body and your mind.

text:
En México el concierto de SEVENTEEN el próximo 17 de enero es toda una sensación. 
Hubo una preventa con una tarjeta bancaria y se agotaron los boletos, y lo malo fue que las chicas que no tenian dicha tarjeta no pudieron comprar buenos lugares, pero espero que hayan alcanzado un lugar al menos. 
Me da mucho gusto que SEVENTEEN sea tan exitoso incluso en mi país, en donde domina el raeggaeton. 
Yo he ido a muchos concierto de muchos grupos, pero nunca había visto lo que estos tres dias se vivió con SVT. 
Son demasiado exitosos y me da gusto por aquellas personas que lo ponían en duda. 
SEVENTEEN, como siempre, rompiendo records y haciendo cosas que otros grupos no han hecho antes. 
Los amo y espero que pronto llegue enero. 


In Mexico, the SEVENTEEN concert on January 17 is a sensation.
There was a pre-sale with a bank card and the tickets were sold out, and the bad thing was that the girls who did not have the card could not buy good places, but I hope they have reached a place at least.
I am very pleased that SEVENTEEN is so successful even in my country, where raeggaeton dominates.
I have been to many concerts of many groups, but I had never seen what these three days lived with SVT.
They are too successful and I like those people who questioned him.
SEVENTEEN, as always, breaking records and doing things that other groups have not done before.
I love you and I hope January comes soon.

Honestly, I don't see any other group of boys that can give SEVENTEEN competition. No one who has more talent than them has debuted and no one who attracts so much attention dancing as they do.

text: Pledis listen to me, you guys really need to learn how to promote Seventeen's  title tracks.  I definitely can give props for your stellar album promos, however next time work on better ways to promote the actual TITLE TRACK. After the initial video post, there is not one post on their social pages that further encourage fans to listen to or stream their title tracks, and that's a problem.  I know that music shows and radio help with title track promo but after only 2 weeks of promos, the song will be forgotten.  No one will hear the song if it's not constantly in their faces, so you as their company should find ways to present this song to the world consistently.

text:
We are all afraid of something, even those who seem stronger and braver, but precisely because of that, we must continue fighting for what we want. No matter how long we take, or what others say, we should only care about our goal, which is valid and good.
Supporting SEVENTEEN has not been easy. Many people thought that being from Pledis they would fail, as has happened to other groups before them, and also many people despised them just because they self-produced.
But SEVENTEEN is rising, little by little, inexorably and without anyone being able to avoid it.
I am not afraid of the future of each one of them, because they are so talented that I am sure that at the end of the day, they will succeed, I am only afraid that my fears prevent me from continuing to be a Carat.
But I know that as long as I keep listening to their music, I can continue with them.
I LOVE YOU, SEVENTEEN, I LOVE YOU, WOOZI.

author: @andrcgs
text: Do you guys realize how f*cked up kpop industry is, but how Seventeen is so different and apart from them and how they're still as genuine as when they were rookies? Nowadays agencies focus too much on promoting their groups in the West, specifically in USA; always looking for that western validation they'll probably never get. Why? Because to be successful and break (real) boundaries you need to be genuine, and more than a product. More than a trade. And that's where Seventeen gets in; since 17 project they've been always working on being real artists, not just idols nor entertainers. Always wanting to improve and give the best of themselves, never being too satisfied. Being real hard-working people. They just want to spread their art to the world. You can see their organic growth since then; no mediaplay, no payola, just organic growth and success. They're the second best selling korean idol group in Korea, Japan and the whole world of this year. They're 4th on the biggest album debut chart of this year, alongside artists like Taylor Swift and BTS. They sold 700k copies in the first week... That's crazy. I know they're going to be the next 1M pure album sellers very soon. I couldn't be more proud of them. In this unfair industry, Seventeen is making a huge difference by being real artists and the one and only self-producer idols, everything when they came from a small company. Seventeen are legends and that's a fact.

author: @tengwarsoup8836
text:
I have one word to describe everything Seventeen does: overwhelming. 
I'm a carat, and I got into SVT a good while back, because of NICE, and I'll openly say that I prefer their cute concepts over the darker concepts like this. However, I can definitely say that they're still retaining the same element that made them so awesome in the first place. Everything they do, they do intensely, whether that's being cheerful like in Clap, adorable like in Pretty U, hilarious like in Call Call Call!, dance machines like in HIT, or sexy and badass like in this. I know with Seventeen, their hallmark is their choreography, but I'd say even beyond that, there's something inherently special about how they put together their music. They're one of those rare groups, like Cross Gene or Boyfriend, where they can do any concept, but still have something about their songs and their performances that lets you know that it's that same awesome group. Seventeen does a lot of stuff, and not every specific concept has to be my favorite, because whatever they do, they put 1300% into it, and that, THAT is why I'm a carat.

text:
Good evening, dear Carats. I keep reading comments about how sad it is for the Carats that SVT has not earned as much as with HOME.
I think that instead of being sad for what was not done, we should thank them with positive comments and with pleasure for what was achieved.
Both SEVENTEEN and Carats have done a good job, but Pledis hasn't done it as well as it should.
Don't blame Carats, because we are not to blame for what happens between the television companies and Pledis.
We've done very well, but I think YT also has something to do with this whole thing.
I guess that's why some mediocre groups achieve more repetitions, and others don't.
But that's how business is and in that, we have nothing to do with it.
This is my opinion and is based on observation and common sense, but if you do not want to believe me, just think what you like, but leave positive comments, at least so that the boys do not get discouraged.

author: @linhdinh9020
text:
Do you guys read what Seungkwan post on fancafe? I read the translation on twitter and it hit me hard, my heart felt heavily. How he must've been feel to say that they will make us happy/pleased with the content that we like in the future? They open up their feeling and received somewhat discontent? We can't please everyone so do they. Because they make music themself so whatever love or hate, they received it all. They may know better what will happen but they still decide to change (you can see it very slowly step to step, light start from DWC to Fear now) because they can't help it. Why? Like you were highschool boys and then you go to university or find a work after finish school, time can't stop and you can't stand still. You met new ppl, see things in different kinds of view then you grew up. So they're still SVT that we love but not those young boys instead they are grown men now. Not just refreshing but also fatal; hot and cold, they are both. Then Carat still not satisfy, when they made refreshing songs, Carat wished dark song, ok then we get what we want, some of you complain it's not suit your taste. So what do you want SVT to do? Do they not allow to grow up, to explore their music? You want they like in mid 30 then still sing song like Adore u, Oh my like they were 20? Totally ridiculous! So by some way, Carat(not all of us) block their ways, limit them to do what we like cuz their priority is Carat, they want to make us happy and enjoy their music. No creativity is death way of artists, they need to experience new thing. I know that many Carat told that they feel happy and comfort by SVT music ( i'm also one of them), but because of that i surely know that they feel pressure too. You can't always cheerful and happy, you can be sad, stressful, angry...too. Sometime you need sad song to cry out more than happy song to cheer you up. Ppl need all those emotion to appreciate happy. SVT just don't take too much negative feeling but try to deliver much positive side, you can see it through some b-side songs. They are doing good, the quality of album is higher every comeback but see what they receive now? We broke new record then fail at other side. I can see that many new Carat join us, probaly most of them are i-carat but i don't know about k-fan. But I know I love the sound of SVT no matter what genre, concept. Every song is our memory, when you re-listen then the memory come to you, how SVT and Carat at that time, how we take every step to who we are now. I treasure it and i know so do many Carats. 
Well i can talk more but it seems too long anyway. May be I'm too emotional cuz it's 3am here but i still can't sleep.
Fighting Carat, no matter what happens let's support SVT with all we can.

author: @rin_box
text:
Seventeen's Adore U to Boom Boom era reminds me of Soshi's Into the New World to Kissing You. It is the era that new fans have to go back to to get to know Seventeen. They didn't have as many fans then, but that loyal fanbase slowly and steadily grew after every album.  Even if it wasn't that prominent during its first release, in time hopefully Akkinda will reach the legendary level of ITNW. 

Even if the Daesang is not granted this year, there is always the year after that, there is always the next album. I am just worried because Woozi spent many sleepless nights for An Ode, the boys have back-to-back schedules for lives, concerts and TV appearances. 

Popularity is fleeting, after numerous kpop group issues, longevity is what I hope for Seventeen. Carats want the Daesang for Seventeen while Seventeen wants the Daesang for Carats. At the end of the day, Carats and Seventeen only need each other, and a Daesang is just a plus.

Sometimes I found this thing is so funny that Carats need other Carats remind them about voting and str3aming while others fandom try to convince fan of differrent group. As a kpop fan from gen 2(quite old lol), at first I know nothing about the whole voting, str3aming thing, Seventeen is the only group I stan after DBSK, my heart was hurted badly after what happened to DBSK so I almost couldn't stan any group till I found Seventeen when I saw Running man 4 years ago. Thanks variety show and thanks to the etheral beauty of Jeonghan which  catched my eyes immediately so I can find 13 talented, cheerful and kind boys, them became a part of my life naturally, bring joys and comforts to me. What I want to say here is what we're doing (str3aming, voting...) is not for Seventeen, we're doing this for our love, our desire want to see them standing tall hearing the loudest cheer that they deserved. You can clearly see that Seventeen never set high expectation for their fans or anything, they've been through enough since very young( if you know few thing about their company and Seventeen project... you will understand what I mean), they even always remind themself about not to take anyone, anything for granted. I literally cried when I listen to "smile flower", I realized that they're not only young bright boy but also mature and thoughtful at such a young age. Honestly, maturity mostly come from your life's experiences so I knew they went through alot, lot of thing may we never know. I'm just grateful that they're stil kind and bright guys after all the suffers. The darkside always exists along with the brightside because we're all are human, it's hard to share it to others even your friend, for Seventeen, Carats are close enough to share their feeling so can you feel how precious you are for them? And what will you do for your love, your source of joy? I can't do all the support things due to my condition, but I willing to do any thing I can for them. Seventeen has their pride because they know they always do their best and continue to improve, so do we, we need to try and grow stronger to be the back they can lean on. Visuals and talents attracted you but only personality and sincerity make you stay. For me, I want to stay with them to the end.
Sorry for the long cringy comment and my crappy english. Hope you remember why you love them from the beginning and gain strength to continue support them !

YouTube is changing how it counts views for record-breaking music videos after controversy

Everything must come from organic views

author: @valentinasvt247
text:
YouTube is introducing a major change to its music chart system after discovering that artists and labels were using growth hacks to inflate how many people were watching their videos.

YouTube is no longer counting “advertising views” when it comes to the company calculating its music charts. Instead, ranking for top-watched music videos will be based on organic plays, according to a new blog post. Running music videos as advertisements in front of other YouTube videos has become common practice within the music industry since it can be counted as a view if it’s watched for a long enough amount of time

author: @valentinasvt247
text: YouTube’s music chart system has faced a few controversies over the last few months. In July, Indian rapper Badshah broke the record for most views in 24 hours, beating out BTS with 75 million views to their 74.6 million just months earlier. But people suspected that the rapper’s view total was inflated with artificial views. Bloomberg later reported that Badshah and his team purchased advertisements that either embedded or promoted the video. This led to a dramatically increased view count. YouTube decided not to acknowledge the record-breaking numbers.

text: LET'S JUST FOCUS ON OUR GOALS. Don't mind external forces too much such as other groups or music show wins (or the lack thereof). Remember why we're here: to support Seventeen's art. I realized that the music industry is also a big popularity contest, but we did not stan Seventeen because they were famous or they won many awards. It's because we see talent, passion, and dedication from these boys. They never wanted to be the best or to be number 1; don't get me wrong, of course, this can be the best thing ever and we need to try our best to get them there because they deserve nothing but the world. However, being able to produce music freely, send a concrete message, and make carats happy are their top priorities. As Seventeen grows bigger, more judgment will be thrown at them just to bring them down. I hope we maintain our image as a toxic-free fandom. Seventeen loves us and we should have nothing but love for them and to our co-fans. Let's not compare ourselves to others, start fights, or bring other fandoms down. Seventeen would not want that. Instead, let's keep spreading the good word about our boys - their growth, their vision, and their artistry. Let us also be reminded that our co-carats have their own way of supporting Seventeen. Please treat this in a positive and kind manner by encouraging everyone to help in their own ways instead of belittling others for circumstances and limitations that we may not know about. Anyways, I'm just so proud that I am a part of this community and to have this relationship with Seventeen. Hwaiting, carats! Hwaiting, Seventeen!

author: @hannietea4571
text:
I know everyone is worried about str3@ming but I’d love to talk about the lyrics, mv, and song as a whole.

First of all, the lyrics speak a deeper meaning for svt as artists. Jihoon (Woozi) has said that when he produced this song, it was the hardest to make. He wanted the audience to get his message at the same time be sincere in what he put out. It talks about the pressure of being "self-producing idols" in a refined industry as Kpop. It’s both a blessing and a curse for them to be named by the public as that. It talks about the "fears, inner struggles, scars" they have in making music. This fear and anxiety to do well has always stayed in their minds "which makes it tainted" therefore becoming "poison to them that spreads" as they want to do their best always. The "love they wanted to give" is basically wanting to make their fans happy with their music though it hurts them cause they do love performing.

For the mv itself, the stunning visuals really brings out the darkness of what "fear" is all about. They put it in a stunningly beautiful yet cryptic kind of way. Each scene was just artistic in it’s own way and describes the fears they have. An example is Dino with the 12 mics yet there’s 1 missing. It’s basically expressing the fear that their shine as artists will soon fade as several members may leave the group in the future.

For the song, i love how it gives such an freaky yet strange feeling. It gives the vibe of fear and the different layers of the song gives so much beauty in it. Every time i listen again, there are new layers in it to be discovered. It’s such a great song imo i just hope others feel the same way too

P.S WOW THAT WAS SO LONG😂 if u reached here then thank u for reading my longgg rant...was gonna add more but it would just be too much

author: @mochimochi-fd9et
text:
*PLEASE TAKE SOME TIME TO READ THIS*

DISCLAIMER: This is *my personal opinion*

Seventeen will start to be nominated this week, and I’m sure we want them to obtain as many wins as possible. Also, we all know that Home won 10 times last time, and we all aspire to break that record. But I think it’s important that we keep in mind that there were no relevant groups promoting at that time, so to say, we didn’t have much of a rival. On the contrary, Twice will be having a comeback tomorrow, which means we will have an opponent for the second week, and a very very strong one as well, as they have awesome digitals and our album sales will not be as great as the first week. Considering this, I’d just like to state that we may not be able to accomplish the same achievements as last time. Don’t get me wrong, *WE MUST STILL TRY OUR VERY BEST*, but the thing is that even if we try our best and the results aren’t as good as what we expect, please don’t underrate any of us carats’ hard work, please don’t call other carats lazy, please don’t bash other groups just because we’re salty we didn’t get wins, please don’t feel too disappointed and demotivated and feel like our efforts were a waste. Give it our all, but if it ends up happening, accept it with an open mind and turn it into motivation for us to work even harder the next time. I know we don’t have an infinite supply of “next times”, but it’s the positive mindset that counts, and it’s the determination and willpower that helps us improve every single comeback. I find that it is immensely important that we don’t be easily discouraged and are able to look at things positively and passionately if we’re to make the long journey. Let’s climb to the top step by step steadily. Fighting carats!!!
This is my personal opinion, feel free to think otherwise, I just thought it’s important to try and spread such a message across. Thank you for your time :))

P.S. I’m sincerely hoping for a grand slam this week ;)

Edit: I’m so glad there’s people who agree! Feel free to follow me on twitter @jwwmochi so we can know each other better! And I’ll post rants like this from time to time if there’s anyone who’s willing to read ahahhahaaa

author: @kayii979
text:
I rewatched an old live performance of them from DWC era and I just suddenly felt nostalgic. I still remember the feeling I had when I first heard their song (Don't Wanna Cry), the same song that made me a carat. I felt like crying when I heard it again. The memories kept rushing in and I got overwhelmed by all the different feelings I felt during that time. And so, I realized that Seventeen will forever be in my heart. Their music, their extraness, all the wig snatching, all the fun and laughter, even the sadness will all be engraved not only in my memory but also in my heart. That's why I'm here, back again, to help them achieve anything they can achieve; because I know they also worked hard for it. This is not a matter of which group is better because I know that every group works hard and does their best. Now Seventeen have done their part, it is now time for us fans to do ours. Let's not compare each group, for each K-Pop group is different and unique. We should focus on supporting our favorites. It may be a small thing to us, but to them it is their hope. Fighting carats! We can do this! Say the name! SEVENTEEN!

PS. I'd like to appreciate and thank all the people who are involved into making this music video and those who assisted them in their comeback. The producers, directors, cameramen, editors, make-up artists, their managers etc. And of course, our very own SEVENTEEN! You all have done a great job! The music video is a masterpiece along with the song. Keep up the good work!

The “opening dance” is the highlight of this song, but unfortunately the MV does not show this at all.

Both “oh my” and "Don't wanna cry" made the highlight dance well in the music video, and hope that this will be taken into consideration in the future shooting of music videos.  Let their advantages be seen more.

author: @-junhuishoney-1993
text:
i have been a carat since 2015, and since this time, svt have always been a group that divulges from following trends. in the beginning, svt filled a gap that no other group could rightfully master; they were doing slightly bubblegum concepts but with a level of ‘artistry’ i guess you could say, that differentiated them and put a specific stamp on their work. with each album, svt were constantly improving and gaining their recognition, even if they had to persevere against stereotypes of large groups (something they will most likely always face) 

like i previously mentioned, svt are not a group that hops on a concept bc it’s popular and guaranteed to benefit them. they continuously evolve and do not box themselves into a permanent category just bc it’s gained them the general public’s praise in the past. sure, fans are going to come and go as svt moves from concept to concept, but what’s important to recognize are those who stayed, those who are genuinely intrigued by svt’s journey and see the strength in their evolution. i think this aspect is most liberating. 

imagine being restricted to one thing your ENTIRE career, never experimenting, never pushing yourself, never striving for something untouched, just so you can be surrounded by people who are going to drop you the second you want change. svt have always been building a core audience, and i’m not talking about people who are going to pay attention only for the era, but for the entire ride. so when i read that article about how svt should have stuck to their ‘freshteen’ agenda, i literally could not care less, because i know they are a group that is so much more advanced than what they are reduced to. 

ANYWAYS! i have so much respect for them! just wanted to get this out! *btw they all look so gorgeous here ;w;

To show such vulnerability and to face such emotion is indeed maturity when majority will just run  from their fears. An Ode as they are dedicated to Carats their messages for their fans.
This different perspective and approach is so refreshing. 
Seventeen even they go dark shows their colors and song is also structured in a very uncoventional way that is your usual kpop or pop song too.
Isn't the emotion fear that way also very uncoventional and very complex emotion. And let's not go to the dance it goes with the music and expresses it well.
Seventeen as self-producing idols and artists are very amazing in their age. The Carat fandom is lucky to support such group.

author: @yajinzheng4408
text:
I love this song a lot. Each time listening to it, I feel the pain and fear from the lyrics and the melody. It is so deep and I almost cry without any reason. The music itself has the power.
As a carat, it actually hurts me in different way. Why they feel like that? We all know SEVENTEEN try to express themselves by the music. Why they are so painful and what they fear for?


I stan SEVENTEEN because of Thanks and right before they released Home. I personally like their new - or changed concept more than the old one. It doesn't mean their old concept is bad or anything like that, it is just because the time I start loving them. From the first day I stan them, my expectation is what is they are going to release next? Any new concept? It is actually very excited to see them try different thing.
However, changing is always painful.


I did notice their pressure but thought it is for different reason until I listen to this song. Woozi is so good to describe how he and his team feel for the past, for today and for the future.


It is "Fear", fear for leaving, fear for changing, fear for love or even fear to be themselves.



I feel so proud that I can hear so much thing from this song itself. I can say loudly - they are getting better. As one of the most hardworking bg, this talented group give us the great music and another important thing - if there is something hard and unknown, try it and never give up.


Thanks for my best friend who introduced SEVENTEEN to me. I was a person so afraid to a lot of things even it is unnecessary  - that might be another reason why I love this song so much - fear is part of my life all the time. When I see SEVENTEEN perform it by the song, on the stage. I suddenly notice they are not only idol, they are human and people around us. They are ourselves. 
What they fear for is what we fear for, what they struggle everyday is what we struggle everyday. 


They are at least one more step ahead of me. They know what they are afraid of, so they bravely say it in front of people. In another word, they accept it and get over it.


Thanks a lot SEVENTEEN. Thanks for being so honest to us and remind us another thing in a warm way - after the long sleepless night, the sun is rising now.

Portuguese - Brazil [Português - Brasil]
SEVENTEEN retorna com seu terceiro álbum, [An Ode], provando seu crescimento e maturidade como artistas "autoprodutores".
 
Como um escritor expressa metaforicamente sua mensagem por meio de uma "ode", SEVENTEEN também procura compartilhar suas mensagens e histórias para os ouvintes através deste álbum.

"Medo" é uma emoção que muitas pessoas encontram pelo menos uma vez na vida. SEVENTEEN explora o medo como uma emoção que eles enfrentam durante seu processo criativo. À medida que os membros buscam informações internas, a agonia que enfrentam os ajuda a desenvolver um passo adiante como artistas.

Como esperado dos “ídolos que se autoproduzem”, os membros participaram da produção do álbum, acrescentando autenticidade à sua música. Através de [An Ode], SEVENTEEN planeja apresentar suas emoções distintas de uma maneira mais sofisticada. 
  


English [Inglês]
SEVENTEEN returns with their 3rd full length album, [An Ode], proving their growth and maturity as “self-producing” artists.
 
As a writer metaphorically expresses his/her message through an “ode,” SEVENTEEN also seeks to share their messages and stories to listeners through this album.

“Fear” is an emotion many people encounter at least once in their lifetime. SEVENTEEN explores fear as an emotion they face during their creative process. As the members search within for insight, the agony they endure help them develop one step further as artists.

As expected from “self-producing idols,” the members participated in producing the album, adding on to the authenticity of their music. Through [An Ode], SEVENTEEN plans to present their distinct emotions in a more sophisticated manner.

author: @niaferrawr5507
text:
Hi! Just an opinion-

Fear starts in media res which actually worked well, but i feel like the song really needs a more complex bridge. Not the same thing, but it needs a difference of mood like in Aju Nice, when woozi comes after the second chorus (I think?). The song is lacking contrast, even with all of the parts meant to throw us of musically (Joshua's first verse, jeonghan's post chorus verse, etc). Every song should really just have an exo's tempo level bridge but in this song specifically, a bridge like that would FLOURISH. The vocal team's backing vocals for the final chorus, and in the entire album, is so powerful. I understand that woozi was trying to build up to the final chorus, starting with a shorter, minimalist chorus and then an extended variation, but I wish the harmonies were more prevalent throughout all the choruses. Overall, in both the chorus and the bridge, I wish the vocal team was utilized more. Seventeen has god tier vocals but rarely in their title tracks do we actually get their harmonization in the fore front. Usually it's a high note here, a BooSeok duo doing a little harmony there, but vocal team has so much more potential and an acapella, or even just a more toned down, vocal focused bridge, would have made them AND THE SONG shine more. 

REGARDLESS. The production value- the aesthetic is on the same level as red velvet's bad boy. Not mood wise of course, but just the EFFORT WOW. At first the transitions and sporadic camerawork really threw me for a loop, but it makes sense thematically. It really does create a chaotic, almost urgent vibe similar to that of paranoia so good on you production team.

 Usually, I dont appreciate seventeen's full on dark concepts as much because the songs just werent that good compared to their flower boy music (good to me still whoops me tho damn) and the dark concepts never brought out the best of seventeen's visual, but this one is just perfect for them. YES VAMPIRE KINGS YES. Unlike their other dark concepts that highlighted an edgy hip hop sound, this title track focuses in on seventeen's top notch vocal unit and honestly BLESS because it's such an underrated part of their group (more outside of the fandom than in). And by vocal unit I mean the ENTIRE unit. For the first time I felt that jeonghan and Joshua's soft asmr vocals were done justice. AND EVEN THE ENTIRE SQUAD- like, oh China line got good lines? Vernon and dino got good vocal lines? WHAT HELLO KIM MINGYU? Ever since his "Mame eopsneun maldeullo~~" I knew you had it in you king. UGH there are so many good lines. And as mentioned before THE ARTISTIC VALUE- THE BEAUTY OF IT ALL. Like did kwon soonyoung really just make suran wrap sexy? It really is comparable to art. High art. 

And of course the choreography seems to be on point as always, but a live stage hasnt been released yet so I cant really have an opinion on that yet. But from what I've seen, loving the subtle but powerful, POWERFUL, small movements. The combination of crooked, almost possessed movements with really tender, graceful gestures just hits differently. Glad they brought back the 12 vs 1 formation. Looking good all by your lonesome woozi. And finally the hip sway moment- there are no words. Thoughts and prayers.

But yea stream fear. Despite my criticisms the song still slapped me harder than any other comeback throughtout 2019 and it truly TRULY deserves a daesang. Tell all your friends. Let's get #SVTDAESANG2019 trending. Stream an ode. Seventeen really pulled a post malone flower boy, a chance the rapper gospel, and a kdrama ost all in one album like- who wouldve thought? Woozi. Woozi did. Seventeen did that. And yea thanks for coming to my ted talk lol

author: @TouyaBlack
text:
Seventeen is a self producing group which means that they write their own songs, lyrics and also choreograph their own choreography. They are called Seventeen because: 13 members + 3 sub-units + 1 team = 17.

I think the easiest way to introduce the members is by sub units:

Hip-Hop Team:
S.Coup (Leader of svt & Hip-Hop Team)
Vernon (Was born in America but lived in Korea most of his life)
WonWoo
Mingyu

Vocal Team
Woozi (Leader of Vocal Team & the one who composed seventeens songs)
Jeonghan
Joshua (Lived in America for a long time)
DK
Seungkwan

Performance Team
Hoshi (Leader of Performance Team & the one who choreographs most dances)
Dino
Jun (From China)
The8 (His real name is MingHao and he is from China too)

You should really dive more into their discography as they have so many different genres and you can see how the boys grew with their music.

I haven't been a k-pop fan for such a long time either but I really don't regret falling for these boys--
(I'm really not that great in writing introduction posts or anything if there is anything else you want to know, feel free to ask :) I'll try to answer if I can (though like I said I'm pretty new myself haha))

PS: your taste in k-pop groups is superb

Forgive me if I have offended some of you but to be honest, wtf. Wtf is wrong with you guys? I can still remember way back during oh my and home era that you wanted a dark concept and shits, some of you are even disappointed at first during home era because you guys thought it’s a dark concept. Please consider this, even if you don’t like their concept or music, if you really are a carat, you will support them no matter what. Please, for our boys’ sake. You chose to stan them, you should support them and don’t disrespect their efforts. That’s all, thank you.
