author: @gyuhansol
text:
As someone who watched them grow since 17TV, and stan since debut, I just want to share that as much as I miss old eras, esp. PRETTY U era (today's SNAP SHOOT COUNTERPART, similar but def unique), where everything was absolute happiness - small, simple, progressive baby steps- i appreciate everything seventeen does; when all they ever do is produce better music and give us outstanding cbs every dem time. *YOU CAN STILL MISS SOMETHING AND NOT WANT IT BACK.* EVERY TRACK, ERA, AND YEAR HAS ITS OWN PRECIOUS MEMORY and MEANINGFUL MESSAGE. Carats aren't as big then so awards and 1st music show wins are pure hard work. Do not simply dismiss sebong's work just bc u feel it isn't so like them. Some even requested this and asked for darker and darker concepts. Why then? This is not even a drastic change nor a typical bg dark concept. theyre always subtle and creative, that's why theyre diamond-tier. ;;______;; They worked out for us too, not only bc of better appearance but bc their choreos are getting harder and physically straining.... And the song being "pure noise"?? What? Where? I'm not even a fan of kpop as a music genre but it was actually seventeen who made me wanna listen to them more??? (I still prefer band music, ayeee) I am constantly hit by dem vocals and every element in every mv is well-thought of. It all connects. So, please do not simply comment random spite. (There's much to talk about this than outright hating it? i just wanna know who hurt lee jihoon for him back at it again w "still lonely x trauma x sickness-like lyrics")

THEY OWNED THIS COMEBACK AND I WILL FOREVER FEEL PROUD OF THEM OUTSELLING THEMSELVES, STRIVING HARDER EVERY DAY. THEY PRESENT THEMSELVES AS GROWING INDIVIDUALS WITH STRONG ROOTS. I hope y'all get influenced, too. (They are a living example of what I learned in positive psych - how important it is to compliment yourselves, appreciate ppl around you, are there for you, and to whom you're thankful for. Hearing "you've worked hard" is more touching than using descriptive words like "you are amazing" bc you recognize the person beyond his work. Annnnnnnd, I always feel soft whenever I remember vernon's story of meeting a carat on his way home? "We are humans before we become an idol and a fan" uwu)

THIS IS SOTY, BEST PERFORMANCE AWARD, AND DAESANG ONLY IF WE ACTUALLY JUST GIVE IT TO THEM. Carats believe in choi seungcheol's words and hiphop team's rap. Carats believe in woozi and bumzu's music and vocal team. Carats believe in hoshi and performance team.  Carats believe in seventeen's talent and personality.

P.S. Expressing opinions is fine, but do it in a very constructive manner. And instead of creating another beef amongst ourselves, let's encourage each other more like how svt are there for another (they trust us too.), or at least do alternative gestures that are more helpful for the boys (like commending them for whatever good they do, streaming in other sites or other official mvs, promoting them on your smaccts and making trends, voting for them in polls/official award giving programs, or by just sharing and enjoying with friends), The MV is gradually rising. small consistent actions matter. pat yourselves, too. you deserve it. REMEMBER OUR FANDOM MEANING. *IT IS CARATS WHO MAKE SEVENTEEN SHINE BRIGHTER* C: fighting ~

PPS. yt viewers dropping by, non-carats, casual stans, and multis who gives support are always welcome and to be thanked for. to those who are interested, and might want to start staning. you won't regret it. ilü

Just based on the sets and other comments what I think each members fear is supposed to be:
Joshua- time passing by and not being able to withstand it (clock and cockroach)
Jun- his real self behind his put on image being exposed and not accepted (portrait exploding)
Dino- not living up to his members and fitting the idol persona (mics and Scoups watching him)
Seunkwan- maybe lack of self love and trying to deal with how he sees himself (shattered mirror)
Minghao- I’m thinking losing his roots and Chinese identity in such a manufactured business (wearing the robe within the metal grey walls and a piece of silk falling)
Jeonghan- losing his youth or not fitting beauty standards ( white clothes/ background could be death or the flowers on his arm preserved with plastic for beauty/ youth)
Vernon- being left behind/ alone (empty chairs beside him)
Scoups- seeing his other members fall apart and not being able to help (watching dino’s and wonwoo’s fears)

Dk- having to hide who he really is be stripped of who he is  (putting on a mask and becoming grey/ frame of a car flashing)
